body: Don't mind me, just following [comment style guide](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/contributing/development/code_style_guidelines.html#comment-style-guide).

Tested locally, it works as expected in all rendering methods.

**Testing project:** [test-frame-pacing.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/17786922/test-frame-pacing.zip)

<details open>

<summary>PC specifications</summary>

- **CPU:** Intel Core i9-13900K
- **GPU:** NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090
- **RAM:** 64 GB (2×32 GB DDR5-5800 C30)
- **SSD:** Solidigm P44 Pro 2 TB
- **OS:** Windows 11 23H2
</details>

All tests done on a 120 Hz display in exclusive fullscreen mode on Vulkan, but I've also confirmed it working well in OpenGL and Direct3D 12. The editor was compiled using MSVC 2022 and the project is run directly from the command line (so the editor isn't running in the background).

### No FPS cap (V-Sync enabled)

*NVIDIA's Ultra low-latency mode is in effect here, so framerate is limited to roughly 115 FPS to ensure we remain [within the VRR window](https://blurbusters.com/howto-low-lag-vsync-on/).
There should be no observable difference as this mode prioritizes low latency over stable frametimes, and Godot's own FPS cap isn't engaged here.*
